VERSION.value: github.com/freecores/uart2bus master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: A UART receiver/transmitter with a bus-interface FSM: it synchronises to an asynchronous serial line (start-bit detection, mid-bit sampling, framing), a protocol state machine coping with timing and framing errors -- classic sequential control under timing pressure

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: clock-domain-crossing serial reception and bus control

value.built_to: receive asynchronous serial data with no shared clock -- detect the start bit, sample each bit at mid-period, check framing -- and turn decoded bytes into bus read/write commands
value.pressure: no shared clock between sender and receiver, clock drift, and line noise that corrupts bit timing and framing
value.success_means: correctly decoded bytes across clock drift, with framing errors flagged rather than silently mis-decoded

value.pressure: no shared clock, clock drift, line noise, tight bit-timing
value.failure_condition: mis-sampling a bit (drift/noise) silently corrupts the byte, or a missed start bit desynchronises the whole stream

ANCESTRY.value: A UART receiver/transmitter with a bus-interface FSM: it synchronises to an asynchronous serial line (start-bit detection, mid-bit sampling, framing), a protocol state machine coping with timing and framing errors -- classic sequential control under timing pressure
